## Learning Outcomes

By the end of this lesson you will be able to:

- Explain how **Assets under Management (AuM)** and firm profit are driven
- Distinguish the **16-position SAA benchmark** from the **21 investable positions**
- Follow the two-phase workflow across **Cesim Invest** and the **Allocation App**
- Organise your team decision process for practice and scored rounds

# The Firm & Portfolio Universe {background-color="#1e3a5f"}

## The Company & Its Funds

- You manage up to **four funds**, one per client mandate:
  - **Conservative** · **Conservative (ESG)** · **Dynamic** · **Dynamic (ESG)**
- **Fixed for the whole game:** client profile, mandate rules, and **Strategic Asset Allocation (SAA)** benchmark
- **Updated every round (quarter):** market views, **Tactical Asset Allocation (TAA)**, optional stock picks, and management fees

## 180 Assets, 21 Positions, 16 Benchmark Segments

| Asset Class | USD | GBP | EUR | CHF | JPY | In SAA Benchmark? |
|:--|:--:|:--:|:--:|:--:|:--:|:--|
| **Money market** | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | **No** (5 tactical cash positions) |
| **Government bonds** | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | **Yes** (5 positions) |
| **Corporate bonds** | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | **Yes** (5 positions) |
| **Equities** | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | **Yes** (5 positions) |
| **Commodities** | ✓ | — | — | — | — | **Yes** (1 USD position) |
: {tbl-colwidths="[26,8,8,8,8,8,34]"}

- **Numeraire:** Everything is measured in **unhedged US dollars (USD)**
- **Currency risk:** Every non-USD asset combines local asset risk + FX risk against USD
- **Cash:** The optimal SAA holds $0\%$ cash; holding cash is an active tactical choice

# What the Game Measures {background-color="#1e3a5f"}

## Three Channels Drive AuM & Firm Profit

Each fund earns its percentage management fee on its **AuM**. Growing AuM requires balancing three channels:

| Channel | What Matters | Key Trap |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **1. Risk-Adjusted Performance** | Return & risk measured **against your fund's SAA benchmark** | Chasing raw return without watching tracking error |
| **2. Client Satisfaction** | Staying inside **guidance bands**, risk tolerance ($\gamma$) & ESG floor | Parking a dynamic client in cash or violating bands |
| **3. Management Fees** | Dynamic clients accept higher fees; Conservative clients want low fees | Changing fees every round (masks investment attribution) |
: {tbl-colwidths="[26,40,34]"}

# The Decision Flow {background-color="#1e3a5f"}

## Phase 1: Setup Once in Round 1 (Steps 1–3)

| Step | Where | Decision | Tool | Ch. |
|:--:|:--|:--|:--|:--:|
| **1** | Clients page | Extract client rules, $\gamma$ bracket & guidance bands | Handbook | 2 |
| **2** | Allocation App | Analyse full-history returns, FX risk & correlations | Station 1 | 3 |
| **3** | Strategy → SAA | Optimise and fix each fund's **SAA benchmark** | Station 2 | 4 |
: {tbl-colwidths="[8,24,46,14,8]"}

- **App URL:** <https://inno.uni.li/apps/invest/> (compute matrices in the app and type them into Cesim)

## Phase 2: Repeat Every Round (Steps 4–8)

| Step | Where | Decision | Tool | Ch. |
|:--:|:--|:--|:--|:--:|
| **4** | Economic outlook | Diagnose the business cycle & form return views | Station 3 | 5 |
| **5** | Strategy → TAA | Optimise this round's **Tactical Allocation (TAA)** | Station 4 | 6 |
| **6** | Automation / Markets | Set ESG floor; keep security automation ON early | Game | 7 |
| **7** | Fees & Projections | Check Projections; copy to **Team Decision Area** | Game | 8 |
| **8** | Results & Analyst | Diagnose ratios & attribution; feed back to Step 4 | Game | 9 |
: {tbl-colwidths="[8,24,46,14,8]"}

# Practice Rounds & Team Workflow {background-color="#1e3a5f"}

## Practice Rounds & Team Governance

- **Practice rounds (up to 3):**
  - Test the platform and app; after practice, the market resets and **Round 1 starts from Practice Round 1 decisions**
  - Between rounds, holdings drift with markets; automation rebalances holdings to your TAA (the SAA benchmark never drifts)
- **Student Area vs. Team Decision Area:**
  - Work in your **Student Decision Area** and compare on the **Decision checklist**
  - Only the **Team Decision Area** is scored — **Copy as team's decisions** overwrites without backup!
  - Appoint a rotating **Round CEO** to verify Projections and submit

## Simulation Task — Lesson 1

::: {.callout-important}
## Deliverable: Platform, App & Team Setup

1. **Cesim Invest:** Log in and explore *Clients, Economic outlook, Investment strategy, Markets, Analyst,* and *Projections*.
2. **Allocation App:** Open <https://inno.uni.li/apps/invest/> and inspect Stations 1–4.
3. **Team Governance:** Appoint your Round 1 CEO and set up your decision log in the **team forum**.
:::

## Key Takeaways

- **SAA = fixed benchmark** (set in Round 1); **TAA = active tilt** (updated each quarter from views)
- **AuM** drives profit via benchmark-relative performance, client satisfaction, and fees
- All returns are in **unhedged USD** — foreign positions always carry currency risk
- Prepare in your **Student Area**, document in the **forum**, and copy deliberately to the **Team Area**
